reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling in Sala, polygon 7.47 ha. Completed fellings (2023 and 2025) overlap only 8.7% (0.648 ha), so not already felled.

One eligible species within 250 m: the VU vascular plant Goodyera repens, with 23 records. The nearest is 44 m from the polygon edge, and recent records are from 2023-2024 with 5-25 m uncertainty, well below the site's 154 m equivalent radius. Its listed threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness in tree-covered land.
Effort is adequate and above the county median (224 records vs 42; 82nd percentile). Near-site there are 36 records of 9 species on 6 days within 250 m and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: Records lie outside the polygon (nearest 44 m), so occupation of the stand itself is unknown.
The 2023 completed felling overlaps part of the polygon, and I did not check whether the records fall in that felled area. I did not run the landscape context tool.
not_established: Whether Goodyera repens occurs inside the polygon today.
That the site is safe to fell.
Absence of records inside the polygon does not show absence of species.
next_action: Reviewer should map the 2023-2024 Goodyera repens records against the polygon edge and the 2023 felled area, and assess the stand for dead wood and similar habitat before felling.
